HOUSING AUTHORITY SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES - 7:00 PM

38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B

AGENDA NO. 94
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, COMMISSIONERS BETTENCOURT, DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, BROWN, AND SANCHEZ
3. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)

(Staff Reference: Economic Development Manager Walter)
4.1a ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. HA 2013-004, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING A DISPOSITION AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT BY AND BETWEEN THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AND ADVANCING COMMUNITIES TOGETHER (ACT) DOING BUSINESS AS AV YOUTHBUILD AND AUTHORIZING ITS IMPLEMENTATION.
Staff Recommendation: Move to close Public Hearing. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Resolution No. HA 2013-004. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to adopt)
HA4.1

6.1 Approve Expanding the Boundaries of Focus Neighborhood No. 4 and Authorize Funding for Nuisance Abatement under the Neighborhood Improvement Program. (Staff Reference: Economic Development Manager Walter)
HA6.1

8. ADJOURNMENT.

1.
CALL TO ORDER.
Chair Ledford called the meeting to order at 7:30 p.m.
2.
ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, COMMISSIONERS BETTENCOURT, DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, BROWN, AND SANCHEZ
PRESENT:
Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Lackey, Commissioner Bettencourt, Commissioner Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
ABSENT:
None.
3.
WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Motion: Waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.
Moved by Commissioner Dispenza,
seconded by Vice Chair Lackey.
Vote: Motion carried (7-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Lackey, Commissioner Bettencourt, Commissioner Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
4.
JOINT CITY COUNCIL/HOUSING AUTHORITY PUBLIC HEARING ITEM CC 6.1 & HA 4.1:
4.1
Joint Public Hearing, review and adoption of Resolution No. HA2013-004 approving a Disposition and Development and authorizing the Executive Director or his designee to execute all necessary documents and take all necessary actions to implement the agreement, Agreement No. A-4390. (Staff Reference: Economic Development Manager Walter)
4.1a
ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. HA 2013-004, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING A DISPOSITION AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT BY AND BETWEEN THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AND ADVANCING COMMUNITIES TOGETHER (ACT) DOING BUSINESS AS AV YOUTHBUILD AND AUTHORIZING ITS IMPLEMENTATION.
Housing Manager Miller stated he must recuse himself as he was recently appointed to the Board of Directors for Advancing Communities Together and asked Council/Authority to rescind his staff report and recommendation and accept Sophia Reyes to make the presentation. Council/Authority concurred.
Sophia Reyes presented an oral report.
Mayor/Chair Ledford opened the public hearing.
Testimony: Rossi Johnson of Antelope Valley Youth Build and President of Advancing Communities Together spoke.
Motion: Close Public Hearing.
Moved by Vice Chair Lackey,
seconded by Commissioner Bettencourt.
Council/Authority spoke regarding the Youth Build Program benefits to the community.
Motion: Adopt Resolution No. HA 2013-004.
Moved by Commissioner Hofbauer,
seconded by Commissioner Dispenza.
Vote: Motion carried (7-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Lackey, Commissioner Bettencourt, Commissioner Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
5.
CONSENT CALENDAR - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
None.
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
6.1
Approve Expanding the Boundaries of Focus Neighborhood No. 4 and Authorize Funding for Nuisance Abatement under the Neighborhood Improvement Program. (Staff Reference: Economic Development Manager Walter)
Housing Manager Miller presented the staff report on all three (3) Housing Authority consent calendar items including mentioning that the Neighborhood house will be named "Gabriel's House".
6.2
ADOPT RESOLUTION HA 2013-007, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AUTHORIZING THE PREPARATION OF AND ENTRY INTO A NEIGHBORHOOD HOUSE LEASE AND REHABILITATION LOAN AGREEMENT BY AND BETWEEN THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AND MR. DANIEL VALDEZ AND AUTHORIZING ITS IMPLEMENTATION. (Staff Reference: Economic Development Manager Walter)
6.3
ADOPT RESOLUTION HA 2013-006, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING A FOURTH AMENDMENT TO THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING AGREEMENT (A-0601) WITH GROUP HOME CONSULTANTS AND AUTHORIZING ITS IMPLEMENTATION, ACCEPTING A CONVEYANCE OF PROPERTY IN FOCUS NEIGHBORHOOD NO. 3 AND APPROVING ITS USE AS A FOCUS NEIGHBORHOOD HOUSE. (Staff Reference: Economic Development Manager Walter)
Mr. and Mrs. Lee spoke regarding their arts and talent program for the community.
Housing Manager Miller stated that Commissioner Bettencourt donated a piano to the Neighborhood house.
Housing Authority members spoke in favor of the house and programs.
Motion: Approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under this Consent Calendar.
Moved by Commissioner Hofbauer,
seconded by Commissioner Bettencourt.
Vote: Motion carried (7-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Lackey, Commissioner Bettencourt, Commissioner Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
7.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Heard jointly with City Council and Successor Agency.
See City Council July 10, 2013, 7:00 p.m. minutes for detail on this item.
8.
ADJOURNMENT.
Chair Ledford adjourned the meeting at 11:07 p.m.
PASSED, APPROVED and ADOPTED this 4th day of September 2013.
